messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — found an auth hole where org admins can view usage/quotas for all customers even when their role should be scoped. Repro steps:
Alex Chen: 1) Create a role with scope=team:123 and permissions=[\"usage.read\"]  
Alex Chen: 2) Assign user U to that role  
Alex Chen: 3) Call GET /api/usage?org_id=org-999 with U's token -> returns org-999 aggregate usage  
Alex Chen: Response snippet:
Alex Chen: ```json
Alex Chen: {"org_id":"org-999","compute_tokens":124567,"billed_amount_cents":12345}
Alex Chen: ```
Alex Chen: Quick triage: it looks like an RBAC wildcard mismatch in the authz layer — our policy matcher treats `billing.*` and `usage.*` wildcard rules as global when combined with a scoped role if the role also includes `admin:read` legacy flag. Might be tied to the recent roles/permissions refactor we shipped last week.
Maria Patel: Holy — can you confirm the token used is a user token (not service)?
Alex Chen: Yep, user token from U (not service account). I pulled the audit log: it shows `authz.check` -> allowed, policy_id `roles-v2/role-482`.
audit-bot: Audit log snippet:
audit-bot: `timestamp=1769004319 user=U action=view_org_usage resource=org-999 policy=roles-v2/role-482 eval_result=ALLOW matched_rule=billing.* reason=\"wildcard-match\"`
Kevin O'Neill: This smells like the wildcard normalization bug I fixed in the backend last month but apparently the new role-schema migration introduced a path that bypasses normalization for compound rules.
Kevin O'Neill: Severity? If admins can see cost/usage for other customers that's P0 from a privacy/compliance POV.
Jess Kim: Agreed. Immediate mitigation options:
Jess Kim: - Revoke the legacy `admin:read` flag on the affected orgs/roles temporarily (scriptable)  
Jess Kim: - Flip `features.billing_legacy_rbac` -> false in staging then prod if tests pass  
Jess Kim: - Add a short-lived policy rule in the authz service that rejects cross-org usage reads unless explicit `org:<id>:usage.read` present
Alex Chen: I already tested flipping the flag in staging; it removed the exposure. Prod still on though.
Maria Patel: Can we hotpatch prod to flip the flag? Need runbook: who can toggle?
Kevin O'Neill: Ops can toggle via feature-flag service. @sre-bot — create an incident and runbook link?
sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0420. Runbook: https://redwood/internal/runbooks/authz-wildcard. Notifying oncall.
Jess Kim: Also: add audit enhancement — include evaluated policy version/hash in logs so we can tie future hits to schema versions.
Alex Chen: From forensic logs I see the policy_id for the role was `roles-v2/role-482`. Suggest we add an automatic backwards-compatibility check that flags roles mixing wildcard perms with scoped-resource constraints.
Maria Patel: Action items:
Maria Patel: - Kevin to PR hotfix to authz quick-eval (1h)  
Maria Patel: - Ops to flip flag and run smoke tests (15m once approved)  
Maria Patel: - Alex to collect full list of affected roles + affected orgs (30m)  
Maria Patel: - Jess to write audit logging change and add test cases for wildcard semantics (today)
Kevin O'Neill: I'll open PR now and add unit tests for wildcard normalization + policy migration guard. ETA 2h for prod patch (including CI + canary).
Jess Kim: After patch we should rotate any KMS keys used by the admin service creds — ensure no long-lived creds with excessive access. Also add an alert for anomalous cost-reads in analytics (thresholded).
Alex Chen: Temporary workaround: revoke `roles-v2` assignments for users flagged as admin in the offending orgs. Script attached: `curl -X POST https://internal/authz/admin/revoke-role -d '{"role":"roles-v2/role-482"}'`
Kevin O'Neill: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5123 patch branch `fix/authz-wildcard-guard`
Maria Patel: OK, acting now: Ops please coordinate with Kevin for deploy window. I'll assemble the post-incident notes once we confirm scope.
Alex Chen: Thanks. I'm adding a list of sample tokens and request traces to the incident doc. :lock:
sre-bot: Noted. Oncall acknowledged. Canaries are set to 5% traffic for patch verification.
audit-bot: Followup log: `timestamp=1769004598 user=ops_admin action=feature_flag_toggle flag=billing_legacy_rbac from=true to=false actor=ops_admin-7`  
Alex Chen: I'll validate repro after the toggle and report back here.
Jess Kim: Good work team. Next: add explicit test cases (integration) that replay the example call and assert 403 when role scope mismatch.
Kevin O'Neill: Will do. I'll also add a migration check to block new role creations that would introduce the same ambiguous combination.
Maria Patel: Closing loop: minor customer impact expected but we're owning this. Postmortem scheduled in #postmortems once the dust settles. :white_check_mark:
